My head of centre decided to formulate it as above-average performance.

utterances.speaker: MR. WEBER
utterances.text: So is your answer, then: Yes, it is correct you were assigned outside the territory of the Republic of Serbia around this time in the Krajina?

utterances.speaker: RADENKO NOVAKOVIC [Recalled]
utterances.text: In the period of November to mid-December 1994, yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. WEBER
utterances.text: When you were last here, you were shown and it was admitted a set of per diems that you received from November 1994. Was this decision in addition to those per diems that you received?

utterances.speaker: RADENKO NOVAKOVIC [Recalled]
utterances.text: Those were the only per diems I received in that period when I was in Krajina.

utterances.speaker: MR. WEBER
utterances.text: Yes, but my question --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes. Could you look at the previous answer of the witness, Mr. Weber, and see ...

utterances.speaker: MR. WEBER
utterances.text: I -- Mr. Novakovic, I see that you've described this as an award. Was this an award that was something in addition to the payment of per diems that you received in November 1994?

utterances.speaker: RADENKO NOVAKOVIC [Recalled]
utterances.text: Yes. That was my salary increased by 20 per cent.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Mr. Weber, this seems to be perfectly clear what the witness said, "Because I was not entitled to a special remuneration, only daily allowances for days spent in the Krajina, and this is the solution they found to remunerate me." That, in my view, clearly is to be understood is that, apart from the daily allowances, that this was additional remuneration for the services he had -- he had provided in the Krajina. I'm wondering what --

utterances.speaker: MR. WEBER
utterances.text: If that's clear, then --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Well, I'm looking at anyone else whether I have a wrong understanding, but -- okay. Then please proceed.

utterances.speaker: MR. WEBER
utterances.text: Is it possible that you actually received this award because you were stationed in Bijeljina in late 1994 and 1995?

utterances.speaker: RADENKO NOVAKOVIC [Recalled]
utterances.text: I think you got these periods wrong. You confused the period when I was in Bijeljina with the period when I was in Krajina. This relates to the period when I was in the Republic of Serbian Krajina, from November to December, and I was in Bijeljina later, on a different mission.

utterances.speaker: MR. WEBER
utterances.text: When were you in Bijeljina?

utterances.speaker: RADENKO NOVAKOVIC [Recalled]
utterances.text: It's not easy, but I'll try. I was in Bijeljina towards the end of 1995. I left for Bijeljina in end 1995, and I stayed there for quite a longer period. I believe it might have been November/December. End of November or early December I left for Bijeljina.

utterances.speaker: MR. WEBER
utterances.text: Could the Prosecution please have page 4 of the B/C/S and page 7 of the English translation.

utterances.speaker: MR. WEBER
utterances.text: This is a similar decision dated 10 October 1995, also again from Mr. Stanisic. Directing your attention to the lower left corner. Does your signature appear at the bottom of this document, and did you acknowledge --

utterances.speaker: RADENKO NOVAKOVIC [Recalled]
utterances.text: [No interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. WEBER
utterances.text: -- receiving this decision -- did you receive this decision on 16 October 1995?

utterances.speaker: RADENKO NOVAKOVIC [Recalled]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. WEBER
utterances.text: According to this decision, your salary as a member of the Uzice DB centre was again augmented by 20 per cent for the month of October 1995. Do you know why your salary was augmented for this month?

utterances.speaker: RADENKO NOVAKOVIC [Recalled]
utterances.text: Look, in July and August 1995, I was also in Krajina, and I believe my salary was then increased by 50 per cent, and this is the end of the reporting period, the month of October, because we had our extra part of the salary determined for -- on a quarterly basis. I believe that was the reason for this salary increase. I'm not sure, but that is the period.

utterances.speaker: MR. WEBER
utterances.text: Were you assigned outside the territory of the Republic of Serbia at any time during October 1995?

utterances.speaker: RADENKO NOVAKOVIC [Recalled]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. WEBER
utterances.text: Where were you stationed?

utterances.speaker: RADENKO NOVAKOVIC [Recalled]
utterances.text: From the 5th or 6th of July, I believe, until the 5th or 6th of August, 1995. That was the time I was in the Republic of Serbian Krajina.

utterances.speaker: MR. WEBER
utterances.text: Sir, I asked you about October 1995. I'll repeat my question. Were you assigned outside the territory of the Republic of Serbia during this month, October 1995?

utterances.speaker: RADENKO NOVAKOVIC [Recalled]
utterances.text: In October I was at the Uzice centre, in Uzice.

utterances.speaker: MR. WEBER
utterances.text: Could the Prosecution please have page 5 of the B/C/S and page 9 of the English translation. This is a decision dated 13 February 1996, also from Mr. Stanisic. I would again ask you to look at the signature in the lower left-hand corner and tell us whether or not this is your signature and did you receive this decision on 24 February 1996?

utterances.speaker: RADENKO NOVAKOVIC [Recalled]
utterances.text: Yes, this is my signature. And since I see the date here, it must mean that I received it on this date.

utterances.speaker: MR. WEBER
utterances.text: This document states: "Decision. To direct Novakovic, Radenko employee of the Uzice State Security Department of the Ministry of the Interior to the official duty in Sremska Mitrovica State Security Department starting from the 20th of December, 1995." And, "50 per cent from the salary index prize money is attributed to him." Sir, I'd like to direct you back to your testimony of last fall. At transcript page 14074, you were asked the following question: "Were you ever assigned to Sremska Mitrovica as a permanent employee between 1996 and 1999?" You answered: "I was never assigned to Mitrovica, but that area that I went to sometime was directly across from Mitrovica." Sir, is the location that you were at that was directly across from Mitrovica Bijeljina?

utterances.speaker: RADENKO NOVAKOVIC [Recalled]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. WEBER
utterances.text: After seeing this decision, does it correspond in terms of the date of 20th of December with the date you were sent to Bijeljina?

utterances.speaker: RADENKO NOVAKOVIC [Recalled]
utterances.text: It does. I may have gone just before this date, but this decision is true. That is the period when I went there.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Mr. Weber.

utterances.speaker: MR. WEBER
utterances.text: Your Honour --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: I'm looking at the clock, and I'm already a bit late.

utterances.speaker: MR. WEBER
utterances.text: Okay. I understand, Your Honour. I can continue tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: You can continue tomorrow, and this would be a suitable moment?

utterances.speaker: MR. WEBER
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Then, Mr. Novakovic, we'd like to see you back tomorrow morning, and everyone is -- that's the 31st of May at 9.00 in this same courtroom, and all parties will make a good effort to conclude your additional testimony tomorrow. That's -- when I'm looking at the other parties, that is understood as well. Then I again would like to instruct you that you should not speak, Mr. Novakovic, to anyone or to communicate in any other way with anyone about your testimony, whether that's testimony you've given already today or in the fall of last year or still to be given tomorrow. We stand adjourned. And we resume on the 31st of May, 9.00 in the morning, in this same courtroom, II.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Thursday, the 31st day of May, 2012, at 9.00 a.m. 17 18 19 20 21 22 23 24 25
